title: Theoretical analysis assumes infinite capacity
description: The convergence proofs assume G and D are arbitrary functions with unlimited capacity, which does not hold when using finite multilayer perceptrons.
canonical_description: theoretical convergence guarantees rely on infinite model capacity assumption that does not hold in practice

evidence.quote: The results of this section are done in a non-parametric setting, e.g. we represent a model with infinite capacity by studying convergence in the space of probability density functions.
